instruction: Using only the standalone learner-facing English stem, prompts, and opaque token pools, select exactly one condition, two actions, and two parameters. Return the required structured JSON, including exactly one premise row for every opaque token. Do not infer absent client-specific facts.
stem: A client at 34 weeks has an antenatal diagnosis of vasa previa. The membranes rupture, followed immediately by painless bright-red vaginal bleeding. The fetal tracing becomes sinusoidal and then shows sustained bradycardia at 70/min. Maternal blood pressure is 122/74 mm Hg, the abdomen is soft, and there is no uterine tenderness. Operative and neonatal teams are present. Complete the bow-tie by choosing the condition, 2 actions, and 2 parameters to monitor.

actions.label: A1
actions.text: Administer an ordered tocolytic and delay delivery until bleeding stops

actions.label: A2
actions.text: Continue expectant observation for 30 minutes before notifying the operative team

actions.label: A4
actions.text: Alert the neonatal team and prepare O-negative blood for immediate neonatal transfusion

condition.label: C1
condition.text: Placental abruption with maternal hemorrhagic shock

condition.label: C3
condition.text: Ruptured vasa previa with fetal hemorrhage

parameters.label: P1
parameters.text: Newborn hemoglobin, heart rate, color, and perfusion

parameters.label: P2
parameters.text: Maternal deep-tendon reflexes and urine output

parameters.label: P3
parameters.text: Contraction frequency and cervical change only

parameters.label: P4
parameters.text: Continuous fetal heart-rate pattern until delivery
